mapper.update: UPDATE course_days SET day_number = #{dayNumber}, title = #{title} WHERE id = #{id} AND course_id = #{courseId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM course_days WHERE id = #{dayId} AND course_id = #{courseId}
mapper.select: SELECT id, course_id, day_number, title, created_at, updated_at FROM course_days WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND day_number = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO course_days (course_id, day_number, title) VALUES (#{courseId}, #{dayNumber}, #{title})

INSERT INTO course_items (course_day_id, display_order, item_type, destination_id, country_id, place_name, address, latitude, longitude, start_time, end_time, memo) VALUES (#{courseDayId}, #{displayOrder}, #{itemType}, #{destinationId}, #{countryId}, #{placeName}, #{address}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{memo})
INSERT INTO course_countries (course_id, country_id, display_order) VALUES (#{courseId}, #{countryId}, #{displayOrder})
mapper.select: SELECT country.id, country.region_name, country.code, countries.display_order FROM course_countries countries JOIN country_categories country ON country.id = countries.country_id WHERE countries.course_id = #{courseId} UNION ALL SELECT country.id, country.region_name, country.code, 1 AS display_order FROM courses course JOIN country_categories country ON country.id = course.country_id WHERE course.id = #{courseId} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM course_countries existing WHERE existing.course_id = course.id) ORDER BY display_order ASC, id ASC

WITH RECURSIVE selected_destinations AS ( SELECT id, region_id, type, latitude, longitude FROM destinations WHERE id IN #{id} ), ancestry AS ( SELECT region.id AS source_region_id, region.id AS region_id, region.parent_id, SUBSTRING_INDEX(region.code, '-', 1) AS country_code FROM country_categories region WHERE region.id IN (SELECT region_id FROM selected_destinations) UNION DISTINCT SELECT ancestry.source_region_id, parent.id, parent.parent_id, ancestry.country_code FROM ancestry JOIN country_categories parent ON parent.id = ancestry.parent_id ), resolved_countries AS ( SELECT ancestry.source_region_id, MIN(region.id) AS country_id FROM ancestry JOIN country_categories region ON region.id = ancestry.region_id LEFT JOIN country_categories parent ON parent.id = region.parent_id WHERE region.code = ancestry.country_code AND region.code NOT LIKE '%-%' AND ( (region.parent_id IS NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM country_categories child WHERE child.parent_id = region.id AND child.code LIKE CONCAT(region.code, '-%') )) OR (region.parent_id IS NOT NULL AND parent.id IS NOT NULL AND parent.parent_id IS NULL) ) GROUP BY ancestry.source_region_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT region.id) = 1 ) SELECT d.id AS destination_id, d.type, country.country_id, d.latitude, d.longitude, d.region_id, region.region_name, (SELECT dt.name FROM destination_translations dt WHERE dt.destination_id = d.id AND NULLIF(TRIM(dt.name), '') IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CASE dt.language_code WHEN 'ko' THEN 1 WHEN 'en' THEN 2 WHEN 'ja' THEN 3 WHEN 'zh-CN' THEN 4 WHEN 'zh-TW' THEN 5 ELSE 6 END, BINARY dt.language_code, dt.id LIMIT 1) AS place_name FROM selected_destinations d LEFT JOIN country_categories region ON region.id = d.region_id LEFT JOIN resolved_countries country ON country.source_region_id = d.region_id
mapper.sql: SELECT item.id AS item_id, day.id AS course_day_id, item.item_type, TIME_FORMAT(item.start_time, '%H:%i') AS start_time, TIME_FORMAT(item.end_time, '%H:%i') AS end_time, item.memo, item.address, item.latitude, item.longitude, d.google_place_id, d.id AS destination_id, item.display_order AS visit_order, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(dt.name), ''), item.place_name, '이름 없는 여행지') AS name, dt.short_description, region.id AS region_id, region.region_name, item.country_id, country.region_name AS country_name, country.code AS country_code, COALESCE( (SELECT di.image_url FROM destination_images di WHERE di.destination_id = d.id AND di.is_main = 1 ORDER BY di.order_index ASC, di.id ASC LIMIT 1), (SELECT di.image_url FROM destination_images di WHERE di.destination_id = d.id ORDER BY di.order_index ASC, di.id ASC LIMIT 1) ) AS image_url FROM course_days day JOIN course_items item ON item.course_day_id = day.id LEFT JOIN destinations d ON d.id = item.destination_id LEFT JOIN destination_translations dt ON dt.destination_id = d.id AND dt.language_code = 'ko' LEFT JOIN country_categories region ON region.id = d.region_id LEFT JOIN country_categories country ON country.id = item.country_id WHERE day.course_id = #{courseId}
mapper.select: ORDER BY day.day_number ASC, item.display_order ASC, item.id ASC
AND day.day_number = 1 ORDER BY item.display_order ASC, item.id ASC
